note: Mention and identity are two layers (CONTRACT C2). Every surface occurrence is its own mention node with its own character span. An entity is a set of mentions joined by an accepted evidence rule; with no accepted rule a mention is its own entity. comparator names below are generic span and string primitives implemented in core/comparators.py; the sufficiency decision is here, in data.

records.label: demonstrative_plus_repeat
records.note: 그 부품 points at 부품. The determiner is data, the stripping is mechanics.

records.label: declared_alias
records.note: Only aliases written into alias rows of a graph count. No alias is inferred from a shared key.

records.label: head_suffix_match
records.note: 생산 라인 책임자 and 책임자 share a head. The saved diagnosis shows string-keyed aliasing merging spans that are not one person, so this never merges on its own (CORE-STATUS F6).

records.label: demonstrative_plus_generic_noun
records.note: 해당 항목 points back without naming the thing. It supports an event link but pins no identity.

records.label: determiner_head_containment
records.note: 그 부품 and the 부품 inside it are the same thing: the inner span ends where the outer one ends and only a determiner stands before it. This is the one containment that joins, and it is stated separately so that prefix-modifier nesting keeps its veto.

records.label: nested_containment
records.note: A mention and a mention inside it are never one entity. 생산 라인 책임자 and 생산 라인 are different things and stay different. The determiner-head case is excluded here and carried by identity-policy:determiner_head_containment instead.
An ambiguity rule records a candidate identity that was not accepted, so a question about which of two readings is meant has something to read instead of a silent merge (CONTRACT C6).
